names.summary: A 59-byte beacon whose candidate fields are all single bytes confined to roughly 33-63 (mostly 44-57), with sun/shadow steps of a few counts. This looks like a block of low-resolution housekeeping bytes, probably ADC readings or temperatures. The shared value range and shared step values (44, 46, 48, 53, 57, 63) suggest quantised sensor channels rather than distinct physical scales.

fields.name: sensor_a
fields.rationale: Lower in sun (46) than in shadow (53), rho -0.81, smooth. The byte range is too narrow to assign a unit, and the bus hint is weak. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_b
fields.rationale: Higher in shadow (53 vs 44), rho -0.78. It has the same quantised levels as its neighbours, so no unit is supported. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_c
fields.rationale: Shadow 55-59 vs sun 34, with a large swing. It moves with offsets 17, 31, 51 and 57, so it is part of a correlated group. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_d
fields.rationale: Smooth, higher in shadow (53 vs 46), rho -0.84. No physical unit can be identified. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_e
fields.rationale: Higher in sun (63 vs 53-58) and rising with sunlight history. This is battery-like in direction but too coarse to call a voltage. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_f
fields.rationale: Weak sun correlation (rho -0.62), higher in shadow, steps down late in shadow. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_g
fields.rationale: Higher in shadow (51 vs 44), rho -0.80. Moves with 17, 31, 36, 51 and 57. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_h
fields.rationale: Rises through sun (trend +0.68), falls in shadow (-0.33), tau about 80 min. It integrates sunlight like a thermal or charge state, but the range is too coarse to say which. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_i
fields.rationale: Rises in sun (+0.71) and falls in shadow (-0.40), tau about 40 min. This is a thermal-inertia pattern but the unit is unknown. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_j
fields.rationale: Narrow range (spread 0.11), higher in shadow, rho -0.58. Little to support a classification. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_k
fields.rationale: Higher in sun (52 vs 44), rho +0.86. It moves with many other fields, indicating a common mode. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_l
fields.rationale: Smooth, higher in shadow (51 vs 44), rho -0.87. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_m
fields.rationale: Higher in shadow with a spike at 6-10 min after sunset. It follows the same pattern as the group at 17, 31, 51 and 57. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_n
fields.rationale: Higher in sun (55 vs 49), moderate correlation, rough. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_o
fields.rationale: Weak correlation (rho -0.6), slightly higher in shadow. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_p
fields.rationale: Smooth, higher in shadow (53 vs 45), rho -0.82. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_q
fields.rationale: Only 4 distinct values (44-48), higher in sun, rho +0.81. Looks like a coarse, quantised sensor. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_r
fields.rationale: Strong negative sun correlation (-0.89), higher in shadow. Moves with 38 and 42. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_s
fields.rationale: Higher in shadow (54 vs 48), rho -0.85. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_t
fields.rationale: Higher in sun, shadow trend strongly negative, correlation 0.81 at short lag. Moves with 38 and 42. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_u
fields.rationale: Higher in shadow (52.6 vs 45), rough. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_v
fields.rationale: Higher in shadow (51.5 vs 44.9), rough, rho -0.81. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_w
fields.rationale: Only 4 values, higher in shadow, rho -0.89, groups with 32, 34 and 42. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_x
fields.rationale: Weak, rough, slightly higher in sun. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_y
fields.rationale: Only 4 values, rho -0.89, groups with 32, 34 and 38. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_z
fields.rationale: Orbit-phase field, weak (r2 0.36), higher in sun, only 6 values. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_aa
fields.rationale: Higher in sun (60 vs 50), rough, wide spread. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_ab
fields.rationale: Higher in shadow (52.8 vs 44.9), rough. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_ac
fields.rationale: Higher in shadow, peaks just after sunset and then decays (57 to 51). [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_ad
fields.rationale: Higher in sun (50 vs 44), rho +0.85, correlated with many fields. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_ae
fields.rationale: Weak, flat between sun and shadow. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_af
fields.rationale: Higher in shadow (53 vs 44), rho -0.84. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_ag
fields.rationale: Higher in shadow (55 vs 49.7), falls through shadow. [2/3 samples agree]

names.health: Not enough evidence. No counters or clocks are identified, so reboots cannot be assessed. The fields cannot be assigned units, so battery and thermal trends cannot be judged.
